risk_and_incident_architecture.architecture_policy: Fail-closed production risk management. All operational components must default to holding existing positions or halting execution upon boundary violations.

persistent_incident_lock.implementation: HardenedCausalEventEngine state quarantine and HALT_EXECUTION lockfile.
persistent_incident_lock.behavior: Halts event ingestion and prevents order dispatch upon critical error.

idempotent_decision_journal.implementation: Deterministic SHA-256 event hashing and duplicate registration cache.
idempotent_decision_journal.behavior: Re-submitting duplicate market bars or decisions produces identical state without double-counting.

data_staleness_detector.behavior: Observations timestamped behind committed watermark are quarantined as QUARANTINED_LATE.

duplicate_order_prevention.implementation: Pending order queue deduplication based on ticker and trading date.
duplicate_order_prevention.behavior: Rejects contradictory orders submitted on the same trading date.

position_reconciliation.implementation: Daily sync between local cash/positions ledger and broker execution journal.
position_reconciliation.behavior: Discrepancies > 0.5% trigger warning; discrepancies > 2% trigger execution lock.

partial_fill_handling.implementation: Broker partial execution tracker that updates average cost and cancels unfilled tails.
partial_fill_handling.behavior: Ensures cash balance reflects actual broker execution without phantom position inflation.

calendar_anomalies_and_closures.implementation: is_us_market_weekend() and US equity holiday calendar checks.

circuit_breakers.implementation: Tripwire checks: single-day slippage > 50 bps, 3 missing bars, drawdown > 50%.
circuit_breakers.behavior: Suspends evaluation and records episode as INFORMATIVE_CENSORING.

human_operator_override.implementation: Manual override file that can force liquidation to cash or lock engine state.
human_operator_override.behavior: Human owner maintains ultimate operational control.
